assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game sprite atlas for PHIELDWORKS, an oblique top-down industrial factory game. Draw chunky, readable industrial machinery: weathered warm off-white ceramic panels, charcoal steel chassis, exposed copper thermal hardware, bolted edges, restrained tiny cyan status indicators. Orthographic oblique top-down camera at a fixed 35-degree elevation, upper-left light. Crisp painterly 3D-rendered game art with strong silhouettes, no environment, no text, no numbers, no logos or watermark. True transparent RGBA background, not painted checkerboard and not a colored matte. No floor plane or cast ground shadows; ambient occlusion within the object only. Create a square 1024x1024 four-view turnaround atlas, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal 512x512 cells without visible cell borders. ONE identical compact research workbench machine in each cell, separately redrawn at world orientations 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees in reading order. Fixed camera and lighting in all cells, rotate the actual machine on the ground plane, never rotate or mirror the finished image. A low rectangular sample-processing bench, small articulated copper/ceramic sample transfer arm, three sample cartridge sockets, a recessed examination tray, upright compact instrument console, small side cooling vents. It must be visually distinct from a large industrial assembler: delicate sample manipulation, open bench silhouette, no heavy press. Keep invariant chassis and connector positions across views; machine occupies central 82% of each cell with generous transparent padding. All parts fit entirely inside their own cell. This is a new 6-power workbench which combines assemblies and crystal into research dossiers.
